excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is inside a museum prep lab, using a fine syringe to inject chemical hardener into a fractured Stegosaurus tail spike. The spike is cradled in a massive chunk of chocolate brown mudstone matrix. Focus is on his focused expression under cool, targeted industrial workbench illumination. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
